item.title: Teens raised by strict, obey-without-question parents tend to hold more antisocial beliefs, a US study found, and they also showed small rises in anxiety and depression
item.description: Authoritarian parenting can lead to persistent antisocial thoughts among teenagers, affecting their social behavior and emotional well-being. Research indicates that strict parenting fosters beliefs that may justify rule-breaking and aggression. While not all adolescents display increased anxiety or depression, some experience heightened symptoms over time. These findings suggest that parenting styles significantly impact adolescent development and understanding of social norms. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI Lifestyle Desk

item.title: ¿Atrapa TikTok a los menores? Europa acusa a su algoritmo
item.description: ¿Puede un algoritmo atrapar a un menor? Bruselas cree que sí. La Comisión Europea acusa a TikTok de violar la Ley de Servicios Digitales con su feed "Para ti", que según su investigación puede encerrar a menores y personas vulnerables en espirales de vídeos sobre pérdida de peso, imagen corporal y salud mental. Es una conclusión preliminar: TikTok, que califica las acusaciones de "fundamentalmente inexactas", puede defenderse antes de una posible multa de hasta el 6% de su facturación mundial. ¿Qué cambiaría para los usuarios? Lo analizamos en Ventana a Europa. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Laura Garzón

item.title: You’ve Got Mail home asks $3.95 million
item.description: Now on offer, the You’ve Got Mail townhouse situated at 328 West 89th Street is listed for $3.95 million. This magnificent five-storey structure includes eight luxurious bedrooms and nine bathrooms. Originally built in 1894 and serving as a multi-family home since the 1980s, it represents an extraordinary opportunity to acquire a celebrated piece of Upper West Side real estate, known for its appearance in the 1998 film. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Two environmental samples taken from Hong Kong’s Mai Po nature reserve have tested positive for the “highly pathogenic” H5 avian flu virus, the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) has said. A department spokesman said that a research team from the University of Hong Kong’s School of Public Health had confirmed the positive tests on samples collected on Wednesday as part of regular surveillance. “The AFCD is closely monitoring the situation of the birds in the Mai Po nature... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has a new epicenter, one largely isolated from aid by an armed group that has killed and kidnapped aid workers. item.title: Children’s exposure to home wood-burning could be as significant as traffic exhaust, study suggests
item.description: Research finds highest levels of cancer-related PAH pollutants in cities that have widespread wood heating Children’s exposure to home wood-burning could be as significant as exposure to traffic exhaust, suggests new research across six European towns and cities. Scientists measured the air in buildings where children spend much of their time; in schools, sports centres and homes. Specifically, they looked at polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAH) , a family of pollutants that are given off when fuels are burned. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Gary Fuller

item.title: Teen prodigy, Netflix star, prisoner: the story of Hong Kong dissident Joshua Wong – podcast
item.description: Pro-democracy activist Nathan Law and journalist Danny Vincent on the sentencing of the iconic Hong Kong campaigner Joshua Wong to another 10 years in prison. Send your comments and questions to tif.questions@theguardian.com He has been leading protests since he was 14. Joshua Wong has been on the cover of Time magazine, the focus of a Netflix documentary and an icon for Hong Kong’s pro-democracy movement. Wong has been leading the fight against a Chinese squeeze on freedoms in Hong Kong for the last 15 years. He will now spend more than 16 years in prison. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

Many compared him to Chinese actors Hu Ge, known for TV series such as Blossoms Shanghai and Chinese Paladin, and Yan Yikuan, whose looks are often described as “God’s work”. Some... item.title: Escasez de dermatólogos en Francia: pacientes desesperados por conseguir cita
item.description: En Francia se diagnostican alrededor de 200.000 casos de cáncer de piel al año. Sin embargo, a medida que aumenta el número de pacientes que buscan atención médica, conseguir una cita con un dermatólogo se vuelve cada vez más difícil. La mitad de los dermatólogos del país están próximos a jubilarse, y solo se forman unos 100 nuevos especialistas cada año. Ante esta creciente escasez, algunos están ideando soluciones innovadoras. Reportaje de Aurore Dupuis y Sonia Baritello para France 24. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: Sonia Baritello

item.title: 'Peruvian pope' makes jubilant return to his second 'homeland'
item.description: Pope Leo XIV arrived in his "beloved" Peru on Wednesday, a nostalgic return to the nation where he spent two decades as a missionary before being tapped to lead the world's 1.4 billion Catholics. The 71-year-old pontiff landed in Lima on the last leg of an arduous three-nation Latin American tour, just weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Meet 'Popeye': Pablo Escobar's hitman who claimed involvement in 3,000 killings before becoming a YouTuber
item.description: Jhon Jairo Velásquez, infamously known as 'Popeye', served as a notorious hitman under drug lord Pablo Escobar, reportedly carrying out over 250 murders, including numerous high-profile hits. After 23 years of incarceration, he turned to social media fame with his YouTube channel 'Repentant Popeye,' where he ruminated on his violent past and critiqued governmental actions. Sadly, he succumbed to oesophageal cancer in 2020 following a short imprisonment. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: What Southeast Asian newsrooms struggling to attract Gen Z can learn from creators
item.description: For Malaysian content creator Iqbal Fatkhi, making news content credible to younger audiences sometimes means making it less like traditional journalism. Instead of polished broadcasts using formal language, the 33-year-old editor-in-chief of news portal CiliSos Media prefers conversational videos that speak to audiences on their own terms. “It’s ironic in a way that, to gain credibility, you have to look not credible in that sense,” he said. item.title: Scientists find deadly virus DNA hidden in 1,000-year-old manuscripts
item.description: Ancient manuscripts, including the 1,000-year-old York Gospels, have revealed traces of a deadly sheep virus whose history stretches back more than 3,700 years. Scientists discovered that the virus has remained remarkably unchanged for millennia, turning historic parchment into an unexpected record of ancient disease outbreaks. Fuente: ScienceDaily.
